subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should Android permanently retire the visible Voice destination and make Chat the sole surface for dictation, voice notes, and realtime Talk?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but this is a user-facing navigation and interaction-model decision that code and focused tests cannot determine from existing contracts alone.

options.title: Adopt the unified Chat surface
options.body: Accept Chat as the permanent Voice replacement and merge after ordinary Android owner review of the migration and discoverability tradeoff.

options.title: Keep a separate Voice destination
options.body: Retain the existing Voice entry point and narrow this PR to inline dictation or an explicitly scoped Talk integration.

recommendation.title: Adopt the unified Chat surface
recommendation.body: Accept Chat as the permanent Voice replacement and merge after ordinary Android owner review of the migration and discoverability tradeoff.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline assigns them to this review and their commit introduced the dictation implementation that needs alignment with the Android interaction decision.
